name: @saasreport/widgets
description: The widget engine: archetype plugins with no content of their own (the original fifteen and the financial-network set: network, flow, split, netting, match, builder) behind a plugin registry (kit.widgets-plugin.v1), a generator that derives every widget from a project's widgets.spec.json and its contracts (kit widgets build), the guards (kit widgets check: scenario, traceability, cross-project vocabulary, freshness) and the accessible runtime (RTL/LTR, reduced motion, brand tokens).
